sense.text:
“I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night.” That is the key, and that is the reason prayer is so important: the Israelites, the prophets, never holding their peace. It is the prayer of supplication, the Habakkuk kind of prayer, where he stood upon his watch and laid heavy statements on the Most High about being in captivity.

“Ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence.” Just as Deacon prayed it: when our enemies attacked us here, you kept silent; when they attacked us over there, you kept silent. Reminding Him, Lord, we are waiting on you to kill our enemies, and we are suffering.

“And give him no rest.” Give the Most High no rest. Put it on the Most High’s lap: Lord, we are struggling, and we are not going to give you any rest until you kill our enemies and get us out of here, “till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.”

That is how the Most High heard our cry in Egypt, because we cried like that. The cry of our people came up to him, and it was time for him to kill their enemies and take his people out of bondage. That is how we are crying today.
Jeremiah says, “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.” Look at what is happening to us.

“Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Bible calls these nations, particularly the white man, strangers, and God calls them aliens. They take our lands and our homes. America takes that word and puts it on our people: on Issachar, the Mexicans; on our people from Venezuela, the tribe of Asher; on our people from Haiti, the tribe of Levi. But they are the real aliens. The white man is the alien the Bible speaks of right there.
“We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows”, because they kill our fathers. They kill our leaders.

“We have drunken our water for money.” Water, which is to be free, they take, bottle, and sell to us. “Our wood is sold unto us”: the wood of our lands they take, chop up and sell back for merchandise, carpentry, homes, houses and tables.
“Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.” We work, and have no rest.

“We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians.” Egypt was taken down long ago, so when Jeremiah says this he is speaking of an oppressive city, an oppressive state. Egypt was a major oppressor, just as Assyria was a major oppressor.

“To be satisfied with bread”: we have given our hand to the oppressor so that he would give us bread.

precepts.why:
“As for us”, the twelve tribes of Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.”

So we have watched for America to save us, and God is saying, they cannot save you. Just as ancient Egypt could not save us, and Assyria could not save our people. We keep looking to the very countries and nations that oppress us for salvation, and God says, you are wasting your time with that thing.

sense.text:
America knows terrorists are in this country, but it is looking at the wrong immigrants: the Mexicans, our people from Venezuela, from Haiti, from Jamaica. And it is causing a divide in Babylon the great.

“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation.” That started with us when the twelve tribes split; after that split we fell, and the twelve tribes were brought to desolation, with 70 AD soon approaching. But what Christ said was not only for us. It applied to Rome, and to the European nations and countries as well, because at that time Rome was dominant over us.

“And every city or house divided against itself shall not stand.” You could take it deep into the house, with husbands and wives divided against each other. If your family is divided, your house is going to fall: she takes $22,000 out of your bank account and you kick rocks.

We watch these things, like the ICE agent who shot a woman three times when all he had to do was take her license plate, and we get mad and emotional. You can feel rage coming in. That is the might makes right mentality: it causes them to dehumanize everybody, including their own, because that was a white woman. But we have to reflect back on this scripture.

“Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.” Christ called us into this ministry to be soldiers. Every one of us in here is a soldier.

“No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life.” We cannot get caught up in the affairs of this life. We cannot get entangled in immigration, because the Lord sent us to preach and teach the gospel, not to argue, fuss and fight over immigration.

“That he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” So we have to ask ourselves: were we called into this truth to please God by teaching, or by protesting immigration and things of that nature? We all get emotional, but we have to calm down.

There is going to be a civil war in this country. The commentaries say this chapter is about ancient times, but verse 1 lets you know it is future, still to come: “The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence.” Did that happen already? No.

And this Egypt is not the literal Egypt. It is the spiritual Egypt of Revelation 11:8, America. “And the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.”

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians.” I will set the Americans against the Americans. There will be civil war; whether Democrats against Republicans, who knows, but it is coming. They have even shown it in their films, in Civil War, where a white man asks, what kind of American are you?

That is a house divided, as Christ said: every house divided shall fall. Here in prophecy it is division, internal warfare, internal struggle. “And they shall fight every one against his brother”: white man against white man. “And every one against his neighbour”, because Negroes and Latinos will be taking a side, Democrat, the new democratic socialist, or conservative Republican. “City against city”: red cities against blue cities. “And kingdom against kingdom.”

“And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof.” The spirit of this country fails in the midst of it, and the Lord destroys its counsel, as you see in the strange new politics rising up in it.

Even their own commentators speak the code: asking where all the American patriots are who said they would fight back against a tyrannical government. That is two-way talk to the militias in the woods. If you are a Negro or a Latino and you are asleep, you do not know what is going on.

precepts.why:
How do we know who this Egypt is? “And their dead bodies”, the dead bodies of the Israelites, “shall lie in the street of the great city.” These dead bodies are not literally dead; they are spiritually dead. The great city is Babylon the great, and Babylon the great is the United States of America.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom”: called Sodom because of the same-sex marriages in this country, transgenderism, all that filth. This is not the real Sodom; it is a spiritual Sodom. “And Egypt”: look at the dollar bill. America knows its foundation is ancient Egypt: the pyramid, the all-seeing eye of Horus or Ra, 1776 at the bottom of the pyramid, Novus Ordo Seclorum, the new world order, and the obelisk in Washington DC. America is aware that it is a spiritual Egypt. Only the black and Latin Christians have not figured it out yet, so they read the scriptures and are desperately confused.

“Where also our Lord was crucified.” Our Lord was crucified in Jerusalem, so this is not the literal Jerusalem but a spiritual one. They have crucified Christ’s image here, and they have crucified his teachings here.

So when Isaiah 19 says the Lord “shall come into Egypt”, we know it is not the literal Egypt. It is the spiritual Egypt of Revelation 11:8.

sense.text:
Christ is the enemy of Christianity. Write this down: the false prophet in the Bible is Christianity, because Christianity is an idolatrous religion. It has nothing to do with Christ, although they put his name in it.

“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth.” John had seen a beast with seven heads and ten horns, from verse 1 down; now he sees another beast. This is the United States of America.

“And he had two horns like a lamb”: the two horns are the Republicans and the Democrats, the left against the right. And it is not supposed to be that presidents speak against each other the way they do now, naming one another on worldwide television. We are in them times. They are like a lamb because they say they are Christ’s: this is a Christian nation, In God We Trust on the back of the dollar bill.

“And he spake as a dragon”: when you examine what they have done, it is dragon qualities, evil and satanic, from the time of slavery all the way up. This system is a dragon system.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him.” The first beast before him was Rome. If you say America does not follow Roman tenets, look at the dollar bill: Annuit Coeptis is Latin, from Rome; Novus Ordo Seclorum is Latin, from Rome; the Roman numerals at the bottom; E Pluribus Unum, out of many, one. The days of the week and the names of the months are from Rome. It is all Roman, and their military is strong just like ancient Rome. Out of all the European nations, America is the beast that came up.

“And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast”: to worship Rome. “Whose deadly wound was healed”: Rome fell around 193 AD, came back into power during the Renaissance, and manufactured itself in 1776 as the United States of America, made of people from Spain, Portugal, France and England all united together.

“And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men.” America made two bombs, Little Boy for Hiroshima and Fat Man for Nagasaki. Japan had already surrendered, and they said, we going to bomb them anyway. We ain't bombing our good white folks, we going to need them; we going to bomb them little slanty people over there. That is exactly what the Bible is talking about. It was “in the sight of men”: all Europe, Russia, France, England and China saw that destruction.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles.” It calls those wonders miracles. What we call today science, scientific technology, the Bible calls wonders and miracles. That was the first time in history that fire came from heaven and destroyed two cities in a matter of minutes.

“Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: the beast with seven heads and ten horns, his European allies. They saw that the beast which came from them had more power than they ever had.

“That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: an image that honors Rome. Leonardo da Vinci sketched and painted Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander VI, to make him the new Jesus Christ, the Renaissance Jesus; the book In the Pillory says plainly that Cesare Borgia posed for the bust of the Savior. That is not Christ with the crown of thorns on his head. And in World War II, Warner Sallman’s Head of Christ of 1940 was handed out in pocket-sized copies to American servicemen heading overseas. That gave them the cojones: we shall win the war because of white Jesus. When the bomb dropped and destroyed two cities, they took that image out and praised white Jesus.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast.” The life they gave that image is the life of Christ: they said, that is Jesus Christ. In Europe many know it is Cesare Borgia; Americans are the last group to learn it.

“That the image of the beast should both speak”: the image speaks through their media and movies, like The Passion of the Christ, where whole churches rented out the theater and went in to cry for white Jesus.

“And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” That happened in the 1400s with the conquistadors. And there may be a round two of this verse, as Christian evangelicals and Christian Zionists rise and want to make a more religious system. Don’t be shocked; don’t be surprised.

“To receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads.” The mark is not a computer chip. They are experimenting with chips to modify behavior, but if our behavior were modified, how could God judge us on that? It would not be me thinking; it would make me a robot. The mark is something willfully taken.

The mark is sin. Sin has been there since Adam and Eve, but sin is the mark when it becomes law to sin. The mark in your right hand is sin in your mind and thoughts, and you support sin.

“And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.” Buying and selling is business transactions. With central bank digital currencies, if you do anything the government deems unsatisfactory, they can turn the switch and shut you down.

It is already happening. They put sanctions on Francesca Albanese, the UN special rapporteur, for speaking against what Israel is doing, and cut her off from her bank accounts. They put sanctions on the members of the International Criminal Court for speaking against Israel. We preach Revelation 2:9 and 3:9; you don’t think one of them will say, shut his bank account down, that will shut them up?

“Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man.” It represents a man on earth: the white man. And the 666 goes back to the sixth trumpet, the sixth vial and the sixth seal.

precepts.why:
What is the mark? “If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.” The mark is sin, not a chip put in the head.

And sin becomes the mark of the beast when it becomes law to sin, and you take it willingly and support it.

An example of sin becoming law, from history: “Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.”

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols”: that is Christianity. “And profaned the sabbath”: that is Christianity.

Some of you know the law, but you will get offended at this truth when they shut down your bank account, because that could break you. With no money you will say, I’m going to feed my kids, I’ll go back and be a Christian so I can get access to my money. 1 Maccabees 1 shows that what we read in Revelation 13 happened before; it happened in Daniel 3 as well. Precept must be upon precept: when Revelation 13 speaks of no buying and selling, you find the historic scriptures that speak of it, and it leads to death.

“And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.” See what the Pharisees did: they made it law that the apostles should not speak or teach in the name of Jesus.

“Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.”

We read things like this and say that could never happen in America. Not here. Don’t fool yourself. It will happen here.

sense.text:
Imagine they shut your bank account down. Now you can’t pay your rent, your mortgage or your car note. You lose your car, you lose your home, and you might lose your wife, for teaching that Bible. Everybody says, I’m strong, I can go through it. Wait till that day, with a newborn baby and no formula.

“Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.” We shall be hated of all nations for Christ’s name’s sake. That starts with the followers of Christ, but it applies to all twelve tribes of Israel. Black and brown people are killed and ask, what did we do to these white people? Christ said you would be hated of all nations.

It covers all Israel because Christ is our king whether you accept it or not, and the white man looks at you and says, these are the people of Christ; let’s kill them. Black people ask why they killed Sandra Bland, why they killed Tamir Rice. Because you are the children of God, and they are the children of the devil.

precepts.why:
Here is the evidence of who it will affect. “For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.” The elder world was paradise in the time of Adam.

“If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.” You have to enter the hard things to enter paradise. The angel is telling Ezra that if we do not go through the hardships of Jacob’s trouble, we can never receive paradise. If you kill yourself before it happens, you cannot get paradise. If you go join another religion to escape punishment from these other nations, you will never receive it.

Jump down to verse 18 to see whether it is only the righteous Israelites: “Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide.” The righteous shall suffer hard things, Jacob’s trouble, and hope for paradise. “For they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.” The wicked Israelites also go through Jacob’s trouble, but they will not see the kingdom.

So when Christ said, you shall be hated of all nations, it speaks of the teachers of Christ, but it covers all Israel.

This is how it is going to go down. “And Saul was consenting unto his death”: consenting to Stephen’s death. “And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.”

We saw persecution against our brothers in France; it has not reached here yet, and they call America the major hub. That is why we say, do not take the convocations, when we get together, lightly.

You read things in the scripture and say, that’s old time, they ain’t going to have that no more. But “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done.” That is you and me.

We just read Maccabees and say that could never happen. Oh, you simple as hell. We just read Acts 8:1 and say that could never happen again. But what God said is that what has been done in this earth is that which shall be done.

Paul said the same thing, but we read it with blinders on. “For whatsoever things were written aforetime”, the things you read about in old time, in the Old Testament, “were written for our learning”: written for us to learn from, because they are going to happen again.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” We need patience and the comfort of the scriptures because we are going to go through the same things our ancestors went through, and we will need this book for comfort: how did our ancestors deal with it, what did they do, how did they survive? We need that hope. The Christians don’t understand what is about to come, but in here we understand. We have been warned about this last beast for a long time.

“Now about that time Herod the king”, that is the white man, “stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church. And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.” He killed the apostle James. “And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also.”

You think that can’t happen again? Trump joked about bringing back public executions. With the Charlie Kirk thing they wanted to see the climate of the people, how many were really upset; they are testing the waters through the television, just as with the Palestinian killings put on Instagram, to see how people feel about seeing people die.

sense.text:
Christian Zionism teaches that 1948, the modern state of Israel, is the fulfillment of Israel returning to the land. It is rooted in Protestant thought, Protestant meaning protesting, they protested from the Catholic Church, and it is most prominent in American evangelicalism, giving Israel strong political and financial backing. Christian Zionism, Christianity, Roman Catholicism: it is all the same.

“I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel.” In Paul’s time the Pharisees were deceiving the people to go back to animal sacrifice and give their fealty, their loyalty, to Rome. That other gospel was animal sacrifice under Rome.

“Which is not another”, because they were using the same scriptures; the New Testament was not even written at this time. “But there be some that trouble you”: the scribes, Sadducees, Pharisees and Rome. “And would pervert the gospel of Christ.”

Back then they were perverting the gospel of Christ, and Christianity is a perversion of the truth of Christ. A white Jesus that loves Negroes and Latinos worshipping their oppressor makes no God-given sense. You get mad at white folks when they shoot you, then go to church on Sunday and pray to a white man, and worship a white man again on Christmas and Easter. Then you point the finger: that white man just shot us. Black people are crazy.

Even their own history says it: the people who heard Paul kept only the connection between believing in Jesus and God’s mercy, and skipped the middle step, the need to live godly lives. How do you live a godly life? By keeping the commandments. That is what Christianity purposely skipped, so Christ is the enemy of Christianity. Faith in Jesus became the whole religion of the pagan Christians, while those in Palestine kept the law, and the pagan attitude won. That is the perversion Paul warned about in Galatians 1, and it is the same now: the Christians have the same book we have, and they pervert every scripture somehow, some way.

precepts.why:
That perversion is what is called Christianity today. “Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth”: praise God, praise Jesus. “And with their lips do honour me”: I love the Lord. “But have removed their heart far from me”: you won’t do one law, one commandment.

“And their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men.” White men taught us the Bible. The white man said you don’t have to worship God on the Sabbath, you can do it on Sunday; in fact God is a white man, and anything the white man says is absolute, and Negroes and Latinos bow to that.

“Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish.” How? God is raising up the prophets. Christianity is not going to perish on its own. It perishes through the brothers teaching on the streets, doing the videos and the classes seven days a week.

“And the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.” They will realize they don’t know what they think they know. The white man is the one called the wise and prudent man, but the Holy Spirit is in the Israelites, and it is through our teaching that our people are repenting.

sense.text:
They are training a hundred thousand Christians to be representatives for the state of Israel in their own countries. They hire a Negro preacher to teach his whole congregation that it is okay to genocide the Palestinians. Another prophesies over the seizing of Venezuela for its oil, saying the oil of the earth, natural and spiritual, belongs to the Lord. Another, paid to spread Israel’s propaganda, prays in the name of Jesus for the Al-Aqsa mosque to be brought down so Israel can build its temple there. This is the limit of insanity, the demonic perversion these Christians are going to.

“And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.” The false prophets are these preachers. Notice that the preachers who say Israel has the right to kill the Palestinians use no scripture at all. They just talk, and the people say amen. Nobody questions them; nobody says, pastor, that don’t sound right, show me that in the scriptures.

“Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it.” This is the prophecy against Esau, Edom.

Mount Seir itself, what they call Petra today, has nobody living there, and it is full of the same Roman structures you see on the courthouses in America. So it does not mean prophesy against a rock. It means the people who at one time lived there.
“Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee.” God is saying, I am against Esau, Edom. “And I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.”
“I will lay thy cities waste.” He is not speaking of that place, but of Esau, Edom, who lived there. Edom built other cities, and God calls them Mount Seir.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword.” People won’t read this; they will ask, why do white folks hate us so bad? What did we do to them? Perpetual means everlasting, forever. They have always hated us, God said. That is how he made them. You say, I just love white folks, but they don’t love me: this is the great hatred.

“In the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end.” We thought our iniquity had an end when we got emancipated. And from 1863 to 1865 the white man made a new thing, the KKK. The whites from Spain who came to America brought the hood and the dress of the capirotes, and the burning of the cross from the Spanish Inquisition, the rituals for Satan to give them power, and terrorized Negroes with it. So when we say Christianity is white supremacy, it is literal.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” God has prepared Esau, Edom unto blood. They are going to have a violent life, and you see that in the news day by day. God is preparing them for obliteration, death and destruction.
“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate.” God is going to destroy Esau, Edom.

“And I will fill his mountains with his slain men”: wherever Esau, Edom is, their governments. “In thy hills”: the smaller governments. “And in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.” God has it out for Esau, Edom.
“I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return.” After I destroy you this time, your cities shall never return.

“Because thou hast said, These two nations”, that is Judah and Israel, “and these two countries”, that is Israel and America, “shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there.” They said, we will take Israel as the Jews, just as they took America as Christians.

They supposedly came out of World War II starving; where did they get the weapons to go into Palestine, kill the Palestinians and take the land? The British ships took them there, and they got off with tanks and rifles. America and Britain were behind all of it.

“I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them.” God will treat them the way they treated us. They envy us because we are the children of God and they are not; they envy our hair, our look, the melanin in our skin. They will never admit it, but the Bible reveals it.

“And I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.” When he has judged Esau, he will make himself known among us, and the world will know that he is our God and only our God.

“And that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” That is the blasphemy: they took over the land, said it is given to us, and said, we are Jewish.

“Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” By calling themselves Jews and saying the land is theirs as Jews, they have boasted against God, and they have said more than just that. God has heard all of it.
“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.” When all creation is rejoicing and singing, God will have them destroyed.

“As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it.” Idumea, pertaining to Edom, is the Greek and Roman name for Edom.

So this chapter reveals what race of people took the land of Israel, and what race of people took the land called America: Esau, Edom.

precepts.why: Who is Mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So when God says set thy face against mount Seir, it is the prophecy against Esau, Edom.

Revelation 3:9 calls out the blasphemy of Ezekiel 35:12: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie.” They took the land claiming to be the Jews, and they lie.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty”: our poverty, “(but thou art rich)”, rich because we are the children of God.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews”, because they took the land and said, we are the Jews, “and are not”: they are not the Jews, and the land is not theirs. “But are the synagogue of Satan”: they are the devil the Bible speaks of. That is not man’s saying; that is what the Son of God said.

That is the blasphemy God says he has heard in Ezekiel 35:12, which they spoke against the mountains of Israel.

sense.text:
“Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea”: Idumea, the Greek and Roman name for Edom, “which have appointed my land into their possession.” You don’t get any plainer than that one verse. It tells you the race that took the land. It does not say Japheth; it says Idumea. You either go with what God said or with what some Negro on YouTube says.

“With the joy of all their heart”: they were happy to take the land, to steal it. “With despiteful minds”: knowing, despite the fact, that it was not theirs and that they are not the Jews, they took it as the Jews and said God gave them that land.

“To cast it out for a prey”: they called their fellow Europeans, from Poland, Czechoslovakia, Germany, Russia, Uzbekistan, come and get some land.

Their own scholars know it. The Rise of Christendom says the medieval chroniclers state expressly that Edom means the Roman Empire or the European powers, Russia included, and Benjamin of Tudela called Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomite religion. The name of the Edomite religion is Christianity. Esau puts these things in his own books because he expects only his own people to read them.

“And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries”: we were scattered among the heathen and dispersed through the countries. “According to their way and according to their doings I judged them”: God judged our people.

“And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name”: wherever we went, we profaned God’s holy name. “When they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.” We said to the heathen, those are the Jews. All black Christians say that; all Latino Christians say that. That is how we profane God’s name.

Yet our own people were never what they tell us. In Africa we had organized communities with courts for internal jurisdiction, schools and men of learning, in Kairwan, Tunisia’s old name, and in Tlemcen, Fez and Sijilmasa. And their own history names the religion of Edom: Christianity. They said the Messiah had to come through Edom’s religion, Christianity, as the portal, a Lord bent upon doing away with all moral restraints: keep no commandments, keep no laws. That is Esau’s religion, the white man’s religion. Their scholars even show that Teman, a grandson of Esau, is Othman, the Ottoman: Esau is in Turkey too, which is why Turkey sits in NATO.

“For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you.” This great multitude is law enforcement, their military, that is going to be over the believing Israelites. The “you” is our people. It is the northern army.

“And they shall take away certain of you”: that northern army shall take away certain of the believing Israelites. “And feed you, being idle.” Idle, I-D-L-E, means lazy, indolent, slothful, shiftless, inactive, sluggish, lethargic; without purpose or effect. Those words fit some of you, men and women. Not the new people who just came, but those who have been with us two years or more: what are you doing? Do you have an office, something you are doing here in Israel? If not, you are idle.

“With things offered unto idols.” Idol, I-D-O-L, is an image or representation of a god used as an object of worship: the Roman Catholic images. One word: Christianity. You got caught in here being idle, so you were fed idols, Christianity.

precepts.why:
Who is this burning multitude that is over us? “In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt”: this Egypt is a spiritual Egypt, America. There is going to be a lot of death, because an altar is used for sacrifice. “And a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.”

“And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt”, in the land of America: “for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors.” Oppressors, with an s. We are going to cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors. That is Jacob’s trouble, and we have not gotten to that part yet. Those oppressors are the great multitude kindled over us.

“Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly”, and “let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them.” Why will we cry, spare thy people? Because of the oppressors of Isaiah 19. “Wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?” They will say, we killed you, we cut your throat, we ended your bank account; where is your God?

“Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people”, pity, because we are not in the land. “Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil”: he promised he will not leave us alone. Just wait. “And I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen.”

“But I will remove far off from you the northern army.” The northern army is the name the Bible gives to the oppressors that are going to be on us, the great multitude of 2 Esdras 16:68. “With his face toward the east sea”, the Dead Sea, “and his hinder part toward the utmost sea”, the Mediterranean. “And his stink shall come up”, because the white man shall meet death when he goes to that land, “because he hath done great things”: great evil things.

Isaiah 19 and Joel 2 explain the great multitude: the northern army, the oppressors, that shall take away certain of you.

Spell the word: I-D-L-E. “Send him to labour, that he be not idle; for idleness teacheth much evil.”

So the certain Israelites this multitude takes away are those being idle: lazy in this truth, with no purpose in here and nothing to do. And idleness teaches much evil, because the idle are the ones fed with things offered unto idols.

sense.text:
How do we know the idols are Christianity and not Islam? This is the prophecy of the world’s last religion that they are going to force on us, and some of you are going to give yourselves to it.

“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times”: this is the latter time we are living in. “Some shall depart from the faith”: some of you men, some of you women, shall depart from this faith. That is being fed with things offered unto idols. “Giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils.”
“Speaking lies in hypocrisy”, because they have the Bible. “Having their conscience seared with a hot iron.”

Here is the clue. “Forbidding to marry”: what religion forbids men to marry? Catholicism, Christianity; they forbid priests to marry. Now you know what religion God is talking about. “And commanding to abstain from meats”: they have Lent, forty days of no meat.

“Which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.” You will be doing all this because you got seduced, and you got seduced because you were idle, I-D-L-E, so you were given Christianity, I-D-O-L. Christianity is an idolatrous religion.

precepts.why: What is the truth that those who believe know? “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.” The truth is God’s laws, the very thing the doctrines of devils lead you away from.

“And then shall many be offended”: many of you shall be offended. What are you going to do? “And shall betray one another”: you are going to betray the believing brothers and sisters. “And shall hate one another”: you shall hate us.

“And many false prophets shall rise”: that is this Christianity. On TikTok everybody is a pastor, every man, woman, boy and girl, out of nowhere. “And shall deceive many.” That is the departing from the faith Paul foretold.

“For false Christs and false prophets shall rise”: TikTok, Instagram. “And shall shew signs and wonders.” These Christians under fake Israel’s banner get millions of dollars, and America works her science for Israel. Remember that Revelation called the fire from heaven wonders on the earth.

“To seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.” There will be a seducing spirit in the last days to get us back into Christianity, back into colonialism, back into that damnable slave religion called Christianity.

That is the same seducing spirit of 1 Timothy 4:1, “giving heed to seducing spirits.” Mark is addressing it, Matthew is addressing it, and Paul is addressing it to Timothy about the last days. These days.

sense.text:
“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up.” The Euphrates runs from Iraq up through Syria to Turkey. They have dams along it, and nations are angry about that, because whoever controls the water controls the agriculture. And the Euphrates is drying up due to severe droughts. It is being dried up right in front of us. We are in these days.

“That the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Don’t tell us the Bible ain’t true. You want to play games and go back into Christianity, go; there are no bars on the door. People say, I don’t know if the Bible is true. Shut your black lips. The Bible is the only true book on the earth. You won’t read this in the Quran, the Gilgamesh epic, or the Egyptian Book of the Dead.

“And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon”: write this down, politics, NATO. “And out of the mouth of the beast”: the USA, America, its financial system. “And out of the mouth of the false prophet”: religion, and that false prophet is Christianity.

The beast’s financial system is SWIFT, which America set up with the US dollar to do buying and selling with the nations. Now the BRICS nations are building the BRICS Bridge, a digital payment system to trade without the dollar, and everything is going digital: you pay in a store with the phone in your right hand. Venezuela was selling oil to China and Russia in their currencies, not in the dollar, and America did not let Venezuela get away with it. You think it will let Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa get away with it? We are getting closer. Politics, economy and religion: those are the three spirits.

“For they are the spirits of devils”: those three, politics, economics and religion, are the spirits of devils. “Working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world”: their presidents and prime ministers. “To gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.”

All three spirits lead to war, and all three come from this white man. It is going to cause war on top of war like we have never seen.

precepts.why:
Who are the kings of the east? “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots”: the Arabs. “And the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.”

“Also the Carmanians”, the Carmanians are Iran, “raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” That is Israel: they are going to waste a portion of the land of Israel.

So the Euphrates drying up prepares the way for these kings of the east, the Arabs and the Iranians.

sense.text:
What we are about to read is the destruction of Babylon, Edom, the one David said ought to be destroyed. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground”, because you have been taken down, defeated. “There is no throne”: your throne is finished, it is over.

“O daughter of the Chaldeans”: the Chaldeans there are the Israelis. Write that down.

“For thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” Babylon calls herself tender and delicate as the United States of America: we are a Christian nation, we have two horns like a lamb, Republicans and Democrats, in God we trust.

“Take the millstones, and grind meal.” That is work, and the kind of work is slavery. God is telling America, these Europeans, get ready for slavery.

“Uncover thy locks”: as a tender and delicate virgin her head is covered, and God says, we are going to uncover it. “Make bare the leg”: lift that dress to the calf. “Uncover the thigh”: now the dress is lifted to her hips.

“Pass over the rivers”: the rivers are the word of God. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets are opening the word of God and saying, no, she is not Christian, because of this, this and that. Look at what America is doing, and this is what the Bible says about it.

“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered.” How will America’s nakedness be uncovered? Through the prophets. The brothers on the streets, on YouTube, the brothers traveling, must uncover America’s nakedness, reveal her wickedness. “Yea, thy shame shall be seen”: the airstrikes on Nigeria, the capture of Maduro, Iraq and Libya thriving before the invasion and destroyed after, Haiti thriving under Papa Doc until they convinced Haitians to get rid of him for democracy, Panama’s military destroyed under the pretext of Noriega so the canal would stay under America’s control. That is their nakedness and shame. They say they are Christian. No, they are not. This is a bully country: might makes right, we want to take Greenland, what can Denmark do to us? They have gone into the decadence of arrogance, and they are on their way out.

“I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” Christ is not coming back as a man; he is coming back as God. Only a God can take down the United States of America. Russia can’t do it; China can’t do it. Only America has bases all over the world.

“As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.” Jesus Christ is the Holy One of Israel. He is not the Holy One of China or of America. He is the Holy One of the real Israel that is in captivity.

“Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness”: this is what Christ is saying to America. “O daughter of the Chaldeans”, that is Israel. “For thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms”: you shall no more be called Christian or Judeo-Christian. That is going to be finished.

“I was wroth with my people.” Wroth means angry. The pictures of slavery, the slave ships, the iron yokes on our necks, the lynchings, all the murders and deaths from the time of slavery all the way up: that is God being wroth with his people. He allowed the white man to beat the hell out of us. Those torture devices were made to break the mind, until your manhood is gone and your will to be free is broken, and that is what black people are today.

“I have polluted mine inheritance”: God polluted us with man-made religions, from Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, to the Protestants, the Baptists, the Mormons of 1830, the Seventh-day Adventists of 1863, the Jehovah’s Witnesses of 1872, and the Pentecostals of 1901, while we went from slavery to Jim Crow. None of them is after Christ.

“And given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy.” The white man, this Christian nation, as they say, showed us no mercy. “Upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke”: on our ancient, the oldest people among us.

“And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever”: I will be Christian forever, as America says. “So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart”: they did not consider the evil they did to God’s people. “Neither didst remember the latter end of it.” They have the Bible and know what it says will happen at the latter end, and they say, ah, God ain’t going to do nothing.

“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures”: the lifestyles of the rich and famous, champagne wishes and caviar dreams, which made Negroes jealous and envious. “That dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Only the Most High can say I am. They are setting themselves up as God on earth.

“I shall not sit as a widow”: I will never be a widow; I will always have my allies. “Neither shall I know the loss of children”: my citizens will not die.

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children”: their citizens here will be put to death. That is the prophecy. “And widowhood”: their allies are all going to cut them loose. “They shall come upon thee in their perfection.”

“For the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.” You thought America don’t have witchcraft? Their science and technology, God calls it all witchcraft. The Havana syndrome gave US and Canadian embassy workers bloody noses, headaches and dizziness, and now a mystery weapon brought Venezuelan soldiers to their knees, bleeding through the nose and vomiting blood, in the raid to capture Maduro. They experimented first, as they did on the Panamanian people before Desert Storm; now they say they have it down pat. That is their sorcery and their enchantment.

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me.” Before social media nobody could see what they did; that is why they want to control social media now, because everybody sees it. It is only because of the internet that we see these things, like the Panama deception and Gaddafi.

“Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee.” Look up the word science: it means knowledge. “And thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” That is the attitude Donald Trump has: the most powerful, most lethal military, nobody can take us, pushing other presidents out of the way, touching the crown prince of Saudi Arabia when nobody is allowed to. That is Romans 9:17 again, and the prophecy leaps off the page when this man speaks.

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth.” This is the prophecy of what will happen to this country. It is going to be a shock when America’s allies turn on her, and when the terrorists get loose in this system. “And desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.”

“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries”: God says, stand still and use your science, your sorcery, your technology. “Wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” Their youth is July 4th, 1776. The Masons designed the streets of Washington DC into the pentagram, the goat’s head, a satanic symbol. From their youth they have been evil and using sorcery. America is the youngest nation, and July 4th, 2026 is its 250th birthday. They say kingdoms don’t go past 250. Watch what is going to happen.

“Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.” Their astrologers, stargazers and monthly prognosticators are the people in their military, their higher-ups, generals, admirals, and scientists who examine the stars, set up the golden dome they want, and create this missile and that missile. God calls them sorcerers.

“Behold, they shall be as stubble”: burnt up, destroyed. “The fire shall burn them”: nuclear fire, God’s fire. “They shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.” There is no comfort for Babylon.

“Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants”: the corporations are their merchants, “from thy youth.” “They shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.”

precepts.why:
Who is the virgin daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Destroy it, destroy it.

“O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed.” Edom is now called the daughter of Babylon, and Edom is destined to be destroyed. So Isaiah 47 is the destruction of Babylon: Edom.

What kind of work is grinding meal? Samson listened to Delilah, who was paid to destroy this mighty black man. She was a black woman, not an Israelite but a Hamite, a good-looking Hamite; he told her his secrets, and the Philistines came in and cut his hair. “But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.”

They made Samson a slave. When it says they made him grind, they made him work, and that is slavery. Even when you go to prison they make you work, and that is still slavery: the 13th Amendment.

So “Take the millstones, and grind meal” is God telling America, these Europeans, get ready for slavery.

What are the rivers America has to pass over? “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word.” The water is the word of God.

So America has to pass through the word. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets open the word of God and show that she is not Christian.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed.” The wicked cannot be revealed on her own. It must be with the word of God, in conjunction with it. People see America bombing countries and don’t really see it; we reveal that they are bombing countries, and then we go to the Bible, like Isaiah 14, how they made the earth to tremble and the world to shake with their bombs.

That is how “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered”: the prophets must reveal America’s wickedness.

This is about America and her allies. “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the ten horns are NATO, the EU, on the beast with seven heads. “These shall hate the whore”: they shall hate America. “And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”

America is going to be burned up, destroyed. That is the nakedness of Isaiah 47:3 coming from her own allies.

Is America finished? The party ain’t over. “And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.”

Babylon is destroyed during this war, but not all of her. The country as we know it is finished, but America is not down yet; look at all those bases everywhere. That is why “I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man”: the only one who can destroy America is God, Christ when he returns.

“For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh.” Pharaoh was over Egypt, and Egypt was destroyed long ago. Pharaoh is a metaphor for Rome, and for America today: Revelation 11:8 calls the great city spiritually Sodom and Egypt, and that is Pharaoh right there.

“Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee.” God raised America up. All the technological advances America has, God allowed them to have. There is no nation that can match Babylon the great; that is why it is called the great, because it has the greatest technology of all nations. Christ must show his power in it, because he is the only one who can take America out.

“And that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” When Christ finally takes them down, his name shall be declared throughout all the earth, because we are going to declare his real name, his true name.

How did God pollute his inheritance? With man-made religions. “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.”

None of these religions are after Christ: from Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, through the Protestants, the Baptists, the Mormons, the Seventh-day Adventists, the Jehovah’s Witnesses and the Pentecostals. God allowed us to be polluted with them.

“Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot.” The well-favoured harlot is the whore of Revelation 17, America, the same virgin daughter of Babylon. Well-favoured, because this is Babylon the great: everybody wants to come here and get rich.

“The mistress of witchcrafts”: that is what America is called. “That selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” In case you didn’t think it was America: what nations did America sell? The nation of Judah and the nation of Israel, the two kingdoms, sold into slavery. And she sold our families.

So the sorceries she has laboured in from her youth in Isaiah 47:12 are the witchcrafts of the well-favoured harlot.

sense.text: “Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts.” In these last days, are there not scoffers out here?

“And saying, Where is the promise of his coming?” Where is the second coming? “For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” What they are ignoring is Genesis 6, the flood: God killed everybody on the planet except eight people. These scoffers ignore that truth.

“For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water.” They purposely ignore the death and devastation of the flood, the truth behind it.

“Whereby the world that then was”, in Genesis 6, “being overflowed with water, perished.” That world perished because of the evils of Cain. Cain and his seed influenced everybody, even the sons of God, except Noah and his three sons and their wives.

We just read about the fire and the flame on Babylon in Isaiah 47. “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” This heaven and this earth are reserved unto fire. The ungodly men are Christianity, and whatever other little religions you have here.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.” Peter answers the scoffers of verse 4 with this verse. It has been over 3,000 years since the flood, and they say it will never happen again. It is going to happen. And just as there is time from the flood to us, there was time from Genesis 1 to Genesis 6: six chapters, but thousands of years in them.
“The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness.” If the Lord promised something, he is going to do it.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” This is the destiny of America and all nations. “The earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.”
“What manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness.” Our conversation must change, brothers and sisters.

“Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God.” We see the signs: the rivers drying up, Trump going to take nations and countries, stealing presidents. We are at that time. “The elements shall melt with fervent heat”: fervent heat is the hottest heat.
“Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness”: wherein dwell the twelve tribes of Israel under Christ.
“Be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless”: without sin.

precepts.why:
Who is the beloved Peter keeps addressing? “He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.”

The beloved has always been the Israelites. So “But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing” is spoken to our people.
